title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass, Modern Bathroom Hardware | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bathroom with a freestanding toilet tissue stand that adds storage without wall mounting. Crafted from solid brass with a heavy base and a felt pad, it’s a smart choice for modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures—especially when wall space is limited.

Highlights:
- Freestanding toilet paper holder / toilet tissue holder stand (no drilling required)
- Solid brass construction
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on floors and surfaces
- Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Category: Freestanding toilet tissue stands
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Material: Brass
- Overall size: 26-Inch H x 6-Inch W x 5.5-Inch L
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included items: Toilet tissue stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
